CONCEPT_INFOGRAPHIC_LAYOUT.name: Infographic Layout
CONCEPT_INFOGRAPHIC_LAYOUT.definition: The structural and visual organization of complex information on a poster or digital canvas, utilizing elements like headers, multi-column divisions, and color schemes to guide the viewer's eye.

CONCEPT_PROBLEM_SOLUTION_FRAMEWORK.name: Problem-Solution Framework
CONCEPT_PROBLEM_SOLUTION_FRAMEWORK.definition: A communication methodology that structures content by first identifying a core challenge (the problem) and then presenting the details of how to address it (the solution).

CONCEPT_SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE_VISUALIZATIO.name: System Architecture Visualization
CONCEPT_SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE_VISUALIZATIO.definition: The graphical representation of components, relationships, and data flows within a complex system to make its architecture understandable to technical and non-technical audiences.
